claims: As of April 20, 2026, mortgage rates have dipped to their lowest point in five weeks.
As of April 20, 2026, the 30-year fixed average is around 6.02%–6.33%.
As of April 20, 2026, 15-year fixed rates are averaging approximately 5.50%–5.73%.
As of April 20, 2026, the approximate national 5/1 ARM rate is ~6.12%.
As of April 20, 2026, the approximate national 30-year VA rate is ~5.50%.
As of April 20, 2026, the approximate national 30-year FHA rate is ~6.02%–6.30%.
As of April 20, 2026, CalHFA conventional rates in California are 5.875%–7.375% depending on program.
As of April 20, 2026, CalHFA FHA/VA rates in California are 5.750%–6.875%.
